CERTIFICATE_OR_SELECTOR_REQUIRED: Specify either a certificate or the entry fields, not both
CONFLICTING_ENTRY: Entry conflicts with an existing exception or block
CRL_ISSUER_CERTIFICATE_NOT_APPLICABLE: Issuer certificate can only be set for a CRL downloaded by address
CRL_ISSUER_CERTIFICATE_NOT_CA: CRL issuer certificate is not a CA certificate
CRL_ISSUER_CERTIFICATE_UNTRUSTED: CRL issuer certificate is not trusted
CRL_ISSUER_MISMATCH: CRL issuer does not match the given issuer certificate
CRL_ISSUER_NOT_FOUND: CRL issuer certificate not found among trusted certificates
CRL_STREAM_MISMATCH: CRL belongs to a different issuer than the stored entry
CRL_VERSION_ROLLBACK: Uploaded CRL is older than the current one
INVALID_ISSUER_SERIAL: Specify only the issuer and serial number
INVALID_SERIAL_NUMBER: Serial number must be a hexadecimal number without redundant leading zeros
INVALID_SPKI: Specify only the SHA-256 SPKI as 64 hexadecimal characters
INVALID_SUBJECT_SPKI: Specify only the subject and SHA-256 SPKI
IPC_FRAME_LIMIT: Blocklist is too large to be sent to TLSproxy processes
PREVIOUS_OPERATION_NOT_FINISHED: Previous operation has not finished yet
PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED: Could not connect through the HTTP proxy
PROXY_REQUEST_REJECTED: HTTP proxy rejected the connection to the source
SELF_ISSUED_REQUIRES_SPKI: Self-issued certificates can only be blocked by key
VERSION_ROLLBACK: OneCRL version is older than the current one
